gloss: in other words; to put it another way; that is to say

definitions.gloss: in other words; to put it another way; that is to say
definitions.explanation: A sentence connector used to rephrase or restate what was just said in different words.

examples.japanese: {言|い}い{換|か}えると、⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧ことだ。
examples.english: In other words, it means you agree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{怠|なま}けている→怠ける：02379_namakeru⟧。{言|い}い{換|か}えると、⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: He's being lazy. In other words, he has no motivation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{非現実的|ひげんじつてき}だ。{言|い}い{換|か}えると、⟦{実行|じっこう}する→実行する：22146_jikkousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不可能|ふかのう}→不可能：03144_fukanou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧。
examples.english: This plan is unrealistic. To put it another way, carrying it out is nearly impossible.

notes:
A sentence connector used to rephrase or clarify what was just said. Literally "if one rephrases it" — from ⟦{言|い}い{換|か}える→言い換える：04595_iikaeru⟧ (to rephrase) + ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (if/when). Typically placed at the beginning of a sentence.

FORMS:
- {言|い}い{換|か}えると: standard form
- ⟦{言|い}い{換|か}えれば→言い換える：04595_iikaeru⟧: slightly more formal/literary
- ⟦{言|い}い{換|か}える→言い換える：04595_iikaeru⟧なら: "if I were to rephrase"

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦つまり→つまり：03530_tsumari⟧: in short; that is — the most common equivalent, slightly more casual
- ⟦すなわち→すなわち：03367_sunawachi⟧: namely; that is — more formal and literary
- ⟦{要|よう}する→要する：14342_yousuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in essence; the point is — summarizes rather than rephrases
